steps.summary: Added second part 'fwrd33-n2 RD Part B' with cost $200.00 and markup 25% to ticket RD-1015. The ticket parts total updated from $375.00 to $437.50. Both parts are still listed: Part A ($150.00, 25% markup, $187.50 price) and Part B ($200.00, 25% markup, $250.00 price).

Changed ticket RD-1015 status to 'Ready'. Encountered one error: "Ticket is not ready Part 'fwrd33-n2 RD Part B' has no supplier". The replayed procedure had already set a supplier on Part A (Generic Supplier), but Part B had no supplier. I edited Part B, set its supplier to "Generic Supplier", and saved. Then clicked "Mark Ready" — it accepted with no dialog. The final status displayed on the page is **Ready**, with "Mark Draft" and "Mark Closed" buttons shown in place of the former "Mark Ready" button.
